dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Excuse me, do you sell the moon here?

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: Ah, so it's you. It's been a while.

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: I remember that you were the guest who used the Yuheng's code before, and you also helped us rebuild the Jade Chamber. I remember you well.

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: Please, this way. Ascend to the Chamber.
